name: Sikafloor-29 PurCem
paste:
SIKAFLOOR®-29 PURCEM®: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikafloor®-29 PurCem®, April 2023, Version 05.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/8/sikafloor-29-purcem.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikafloor®-29 PurCem® where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 05.01).
1.2 Product description. Sikafloor®-29 PurCem® is a multi-component, polyurethane hybrid mortar. It has high impact and mechanical resistance, good resistance against chemicals and wear.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sikafloor®-29 PurCem® is used as a coving mortar, detailing and vertical rendering with Sikafloor® PurCem® floor systems.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.9.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikafloor®-29 PurCem®
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: High strength, water-based polyurethane hybrid coving and detailing mortar
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer - LEED Rating. USGBC LEED® Rating. Confirms Section FQ (Indoor Environment Quality), Credit 4.2 Low Emitting Materials Paints and Coatings (VOC content ≤ 50 g/l).
2.3 Approvals / certificates.
    - Synthetic resin screed material according to EN 13813:2002, Declaration of Performance 02 08 02 02 003 0 000001 1088, certified by notified factory production control certification body 0086, certificate of conformity of the factory production control 541325, and provided with the CE marking.
    - Coating for surface protection of concrete according to EN 1504-2:2004, Declaration of Performance 02 08 02 02 003 0 000001 1088, certified by notified factory production control certification body 0086, certificate of conformity of the factory production control 541325, and provided with the CE marking.
    - EN1186, EN 13130, and prCEN/TS 14234 standards, and the Decree on Consumer Goods, representing the conversion of directives 89/109/EEC, 90/128/EEC and 2002/72/EC for contact with food stuffs, according to test report by ISEGA, 32758 U11 and 32759 U11, both dated December 6th, 2011. (Tests performed on Sikafloor® -20/21/22/29 and 31 PurCem® in standard and LP versions).
    - British Standards Specifications (BSS) acceptance for use in the UK. Campden and Chorleywood Food Research Association, Ref. S/REP/125424/1a and 2a, dated 8th February, 2012
    - Fire classification report according to EN 13501-1 from Exova Warrington Fire for Sikafloor®-31 PurCem® No.31050, dated 24th of March, 2012
    - Liquid water transmission rate test report from the Technology Centre, Ref. 15456 dated January 25th, 2012
    - Impact resistance values tested at PRA, Ref. No. 75221-151, dated January 11th, 2012
2.4 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 13813:2002: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - EN 1504-2:2004: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - EN1186: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - EN 13130: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - EN 13501-1: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - ASTM D 2240: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Shore D Hardness (p.2).
    - BS EN 13892-2: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2); Technical Information > Tensile strength in flexure (p.2).
    - EN 1542: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Tensile adhesion strength (p.2).
2.5 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Good wear resistance
    - High mechanical and impact resistance
    - High softening point
    - Good chemical resistance
    - Non tainting /odourless
    - Fast curing
    - VOC free
    - Can be applied to substrates with high moisture content (7 days old or mature damp concrete or 10% moisture pbw)
2.6 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Water-based polyurethane cement hybrid
    - Density: Part A+B+C mixed: ~ 1.97 kg/l ± 0.03 (at +20 °C)
2.7 Appearance and colour.
    | Part A | opaque liquid |
    | Part B | brown liquid |
    | Pigment | colour |
    | Part C | natural grey powder |
    | Part D | natural sand colour |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
2.8 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Shore D Hardness: ~80–85 (ASTM D 2240)
    - Compressive strength: ~44 N/mm² (28 days at +23 °C / 50 % r.h.) (BS EN 13892-2)
    - Tensile strength in flexure: ~8 N/mm² (28 days at +23 °C / 50 % r.h.) (BS EN 13892-2)
    - Tensile adhesion strength: concrete failure (EN 1542)
2.9 Systems. As a coving mortar and render mortar in Sikafloor® PurCem® applications.
2.10 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Storage conditions: The package must be stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging, in dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +30°C.
2.11 Packaging.
    | Part A | 1.30   kg plastic bottle |
    | Part B | 1.50   kg plastic bottle |
    | Pigment | 0.4     kg plastic tub |
    | Part C | 1.60   kg kg plastic bag |
    | Part D | 17.3   kg plastic bag |
    | Part A+B+C+D | 22.0   kg ready to mix unit |
2.12 Shelf life.
    | Part A | 9 months from date of production. |
    | Part B | 6 months from date of production. |
    | Part C | 6 months from date of production. |
    | Part D | Not applicable - (inert silica sand) |

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 05.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment.
    - The surface must be clean, dry and free of all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, coatings and surface treatments, etc. All dust, loose and friable material must be completely removed from all surfaces before application of the product, preferably by vacuum. Pull of strength shall not be less than 1.5 N/mm². If in doubt apply a test area first.
    - Priming is required to install Sikafloor®-29 PurCem® Sikafloor 160/161 or Sikadur 31/33 are acceptable primers for various different types of applications. Please see Application Informaiton below for further details.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 05.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: Part A : P : B : C :D = 1 : 0.3 1.1 : 1.2: 13.3 (packaging size = 1.3 : 0.4 : 1.5 : 1.6 : 17.3) by weight. Mix full units only.
    - Consumption: ~ 2.0 kg/m²/mm
    - Layer thickness: 3–9 mm
4.3 Pot Life.
    | Temperatures | Time |
    | +10 °C | ~ 35–40 minutes |
    | +20 °C | ~ 22–25 minutes |
    | +30 °C | ~ 15–18 minutes |
    | +35 °C | ~ 12–15 minutes |
4.4 Curing time. Before overcoating Sikafloor®-29 PurCem® allow:
    | Substrate temperature | Minimum | Maximum |
    | +10 °C | 20 hours | 72 hours |
    | +20 °C | 10 hours | 48 hours |
    | +30 °C | 5 hours | 24 hours |
    | +35 °C | 5 hours | 24 hours |
    Times are approximate and will be affected be changing ambient and substrate conditions, particularly temperature and relative humidity.
4.5 Mixing.
    - Premix part A with a low speed electric stirrer and then add pigment and mix until uniform. Add part B and mix for 30 seconds. Make sure all pigment is uniformly distributed. Use a double paddle (axis) mixer and gradually add part C & D (aggregate) to the mixed resin. DON’T DUMP!
    - Allow part C & D to blend for further 2 minutes minimum, to ensure complete mixing and a uniform moist mix is obtained. During the operations, scrape down the sides and bottom of the container with a flat or straight edge trowel at least once (parts A+P+B+C+D) to ensure complete mixing. Mix full units only. Mixing tools
    - Use a low speed electric stirrer (300-400 rpm) for mixing parts A and B. For preparation of the mortar mix use a pan type revolving mixer.
4.6 Application - Priming.
    - Subject to the various applications, different epoxy primers can be used, For standard coves under 100mm in Height, Sikafloor 160/161 should be used. For concrete kerbs and vertical renders, Sikadur 31/33 Can be used, for vertical applications apply the Sikadur 31/33 by way of a 4mm V-Notch Trowel prior to the application of Sikafloor®-29 PurCem® the Thixotropic Nature of the Sikadur 31/33 Adhesives will greatly aid in the ability of the Sikafloor®-29 PurCem® to hold in place on vertical applications.
    - Application of Sikafloor®-29 PurCem®
    - Apply the mixed Sikafloor®-29 PurCem® onto the ready primed substrate and compact to the appropriate thickness, then finish the detailing profile with a coving trowel or steel float. Apply Sikafloor®-29 PurCem® while the primer is still tacky. If the primer becomes tack free, reapply the primer.
4.7 Application - Top Coats. Sikafloor®-29 PurCem® Is fully servicable without top coats, however in order to provide a smoother and more colour consistent finish, 1-2 x Coats of Sikafloor 31 PurCem top Coat should be applied.
4.8 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment with Thinner C immediately after use. Hardened/cured material can only be mechanically removed.
4.9 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Do not apply to PCC (polymer modified cement mortars) that may expand due to moisture when sealed with an impervious resin.
    - Always ensure good ventilation when using Sikafloor®-29 PurCem® in a confined space, to prevent excessive ambient humidity.
    - Freshly applied Sikafloor®-29 PurCem®, must be protected from damp, condensation and direct water contact (rain) for at least 24 hours.
    - Protect the substrate during application from condensation from pipes or any overhead leaks.
    - Do not apply to cracked or unsound substrates.
    - Always allow a minimum of 48 hours after product application prior to placing into service in proximity with food stuffs.
    - Products of the Sikafloor® PurCem® product range are subject to discolouration when exposed to UV radiation. Extend depends on colour. There are no measurable losses of any properties when this occurs and it is a purely aesthetical matter. Products can be used outside provided the change in appearance is acceptable by the customer.
    - In some slow curing conditions, soiling of the surface may occur when opened to foot traffic, even though mechanical properties have been achieved. It is advised to remove dirt using a dry mop or cloth. Avoid scrubbing with water for the first three days.
4.10 Further information - Please refer to.
    - Sikafloor® PurCem® Method Statement
    - Sika® Method Statement Mixing and Application of Flooring Systems
    - Sika® Method Statement Surface Evaluation & Preparation
    - Sikafloor® PurCem® System Data Sheets

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +10 °C min. / +40 °C max.
5.3 Relative air humidity. 85 % max.
5.4 Dew point. Beware of condensation! The substrate and uncured floor must be at least 3 °C above dew point to reduce the risk of condensation or blooming on the floor finish.
5.5 Substrate temperature. +10 °C min. / +40 °C max.
5.6 Substrate moisture content. Can be installed on substrates with higher moisture content. No ponding water. Check rising moisture. The substrate needs to be visibly dry and have adequate pull-off strength min 1.5 N/mm².
5.7 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.9):
    - Do not apply to PCC (polymer modified cement mortars) that may expand due to moisture when sealed with an impervious resin.
    - Always ensure good ventilation when using Sikafloor®-29 PurCem® in a confined space, to prevent excessive ambient humidity.
    - Freshly applied Sikafloor®-29 PurCem®, must be protected from damp, condensation and direct water contact (rain) for at least 24 hours.
5.8 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Can be installed on substrates with higher moisture content. No ponding water. Check rising moisture. The substrate needs to be visibly dry and have adequate pull-off strength min 1.5 N/mm².
    - The surface must be clean, dry and free of all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, coatings and surface treatments, etc. All dust, loose and friable material must be completely removed from all surfaces before application of the product, preferably by vacuum. Pull of strength shall not be less than 1.5 N/mm². If in doubt apply a test area first.
5.9 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Shore D Hardness: ~80–85 (ASTM D 2240)
    - Compressive strength: ~44 N/mm² (28 days at +23 °C / 50 % r.h.) (BS EN 13892-2)
    - Tensile strength in flexure: ~8 N/mm² (28 days at +23 °C / 50 % r.h.) (BS EN 13892-2)
    - Tensile adhesion strength: concrete failure (EN 1542)
5.10 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.11 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikafloor®-29 PurCem®, April 2023, Version 05.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/8/sikafloor-29-purcem.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sikafloor 31 / 29 Purcem Part C, version 29/08/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/SDS%20Sikafloor%20-%2031-29%20PurCem%20Part%20C%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikafloor®-29 PurCem® Part C, version 14/12/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/sds-sikafloor-29purcempartc.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sikafloor 29 / 31 / 33 N Purcem Part A, version 09/09/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/p/SDS%20Sikafloor%20-%2029-31-33N%20PurCem%20(A)%20AU%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sikafloor 29 PurCem Part D, version 11/09/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/8/Sikafloor%2029%20Purcem%20Part%20D%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sikafloor 31/29 Purcem Part B, version 09/09/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/SDS%20Sikafloor%20-%2031-29%20PurCem%20Part%20B%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikafloor®-29/31/33 N PurCem® Part A, version 13/04/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/sds-sikafloor-293133npurcemparta.pdf
    - Brochure: SikaFloor: Resin Flooring Solutions, version 08/11/2023, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/l/Sikafloor%20Resin%20BROCHURE%202023%20FIN%20DIGI.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
